## Goal

Cool the batch to its target temperature as fast as possible without ruining it.

The liquid holds less dissolved material as it cools. Whatever it cannot hold is the supersaturation, the reading sigma: sigma = 0.10 means ten percent more is dissolved than the liquid can hold at the current temperature. Supersaturation makes the seed crystals grow, and growth uses it up, so at constant temperature sigma falls back towards zero; the more crystal surface there is, the faster.
